provenance.method: Unauthenticated HTTPS GET of public YouTube channel /videos and each public watch page; parsed ytInitialData and ytInitialPlayerResponse videoDetails and microformat. No private API or credentials used.
provenance.webSearchLimitation: YouTube opens through web search return DisabledError; raw public HTML reads succeed. No browser session was used.
provenance.scope: Nine videos exposed by the public Videos tab were inspected. No claim of complete private or unlisted catalog.
provenance.playbackLimitation: Metadata only; sound and actual embed playback were not listened to or visually reviewed.
